title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Rosales, in the Municipality of Calbayog, Province of Samar, to Obrero.

text.en:
The name of the barrio of Rosales, in the municipality of Calbayog, Province of Samar, to all
intents and purposes, shall hereafter be known as Obrero.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1935.
